question: Summarize the Orion Systems MSA redlines

intro.title: Meet Sofia's workspace
intro.text: Sofia Reyes, Senior Legal Counsel. 38 contracts in review, 54 open matters, one $1.24M renewal on the clock. Her whole day, one screen.

hero.title: The brief knows the stakes
hero.text: Before coffee: close the Orion liability-cap counter before Marcus's 10:30 call. The $1.24M renewal hangs on it. No inbox digging required.

kpis.title: Numbers that pull weight
kpis.text: Turnaround down to 6.8 days despite July's intake spike — and 72.4% of NDAs now clear themselves, up 8.3 points on Q2.

chart.title: 138 in, 135 out
chart.text: July intake hit 138 on the Q3 sales push. The team completed 135. Backlog barely moved — that's the story this sweep tells.

ask.title: Drag, drop, interrogate
ask.text: Sofia drags a KPI straight into chat and asks for the Orion redline summary — the one blocking her 10:30.

delegate.title: Three DPAs, zero chasing
delegate.text: One click: DPA templates go to Elena's three Ariba vendors, reminders set, one signed same day. Sofia never opened DocuSign.

autopilot.title: Approvals on autopilot
autopilot.text: Flip the switch — low-risk items like Latham's data-room access clear themselves. The $1.24M Orion cap exception still waits for Sofia.

mcp.title: Plugged into everything
mcp.text: DocuSign, SharePoint, Confluence, Outlook — all live under the hood. Every answer traced back to the systems legal already trusts.

recap.title: Friday report, one click
recap.text: The week writes itself: queue held at 38, four stale envelopes cleared, board litigation summary drafted four days early. Priya gets receipts.

outro.title: Counsel, amplified
outro.text: Same Sofia, same judgment — minus the chasing, drafting, and digging. That's a legal team that scales without headcount.
